name: gamegen
description: gamegen: make a complete, playable game from a description, with the art and sound tools it uses.

plugins.name: gg
plugins.description: /gamegen: describe a game and get a finished, play-tested one: designed, reviewed, illustrated, animated, scored and built. Installs imagegen2, anim8gen, audiogen, nanogen and meshgen with it.

plugins.name: imagegen2
plugins.description: Game art with OpenAI GPT Image: sprites, tiles, icons, with clean transparent backgrounds.

plugins.name: anim8gen
plugins.description: Short game sprite animations, drawn with imagegen2.

plugins.name: audiogen
plugins.description: Game music, sound effects and voices with ElevenLabs.

plugins.name: nanogen
plugins.description: Game art with Google Gemini (Nano Banana): backgrounds, scenery, tiles and items.

plugins.name: meshgen
plugins.description: 3D game models and animated characters with Meshy, for 3D games.
